sb.name: Avatar of Death
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, unconscious
sb.senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 13
sb.languages: all languages known to its summoner

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: half the hit point maximum of its summoner

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The avatar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.desc: The avatar is immune to features that turn undead.

actions.name: Reaping Scythe
actions.desc: The avatar sweeps its spectral scythe through a creature within 5 feet of it, dealing 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

sb.name: Larva
sb.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.
